subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should AI-safety events be trusted core-only diagnostics, plugin-emittable public events with explicit provenance, or deferred until concrete producers establish the contract?
rationale: These events assert security and policy outcomes, while current diagnostics deliberately distinguish trusted core emissions from ordinary plugin emissions; code review cannot choose that trust model safely.

options.title: Keep events core-trusted
options.body: Restrict emission to trusted internal producers and expose only derived or read-only observation surfaces to plugins.

options.title: Add public provenance
options.body: Permit plugin emission only after adding producer identity, trust metadata, exporter enforcement, and compatibility documentation.

options.title: Defer the taxonomy
options.body: Pause the series until concrete safety producers and operator requirements establish a narrower permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Keep events core-trusted
recommendation.body: Restrict emission to trusted internal producers and expose only derived or read-only observation surfaces to plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work established the affected diagnostic trust and exporter architecture.
